english_retrieval.title: Yogi Adityanath - Wikipedia
english_retrieval.snippet: # Yogi Adityanath. A member of the Bharatiya Janata Party, Adityanath has served as the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh since 2017. | Member "Member of the Legislative Assembly (India)") of Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly |. | **In office** 18 September 2017 – 22 March 2022 |. In 2017, he moved from central to the UP state politics and was elected as the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh. Yogi Adityanath was born as Ajay Mohan Singh Bisht on 5 June 1972 in the village of Panchur, in Pauri Garhwal, Uttar Pradesh (now in Uttarakhand) in a Garhwali Rajput family. Adityanath was elected as a Member of Parliament from Gorakhpur "Gorakhpur (Lok Sabha Constituency)") for the first time in 1998 during the 12th Lok Sabha at the age of 26; he was its youngest member at that time. Adityanath was a prominent campaigner for the BJP in the 2017 assembly elections in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
